snippet.title: CHAPTER 3 Installment 2 Trailer - LAMBDARUNE
snippet.description:
Gamejolt page: https://gamejolt.com/games/lambdarune/960010

The final Installment of LAMBDARUNE Chapter 3 is set to release October 18th!

Due to creating the battle engine from scratch and refining our team's work ethic, it took us 8 months to get the entire Installment done.

Installment 2, containing 3 high-effort fights, is now finalized.

Looking ahead, we aim to complete Chapter 4 much faster with the help of new team members. Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for more updates! ^^

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/caqQwEuWv3

⋆｡°✩FAQ✩°｡⋆

1. Are there battles?
R: Yes. Three big ones, in fact: the rival, Kreid— the Main boss Maximike— and the Superboss of the chapter, Foane.

2. Why include memes?
R: I know that, for some, it's only okay if Toby does it— but we were inspired by Deltarune's Gerson whole speech and so we've decided to go even further beyond, to lands unexplored even by Toby Fox— and include even more memes.

⋆｡°✩Credits✩°｡⋆

Soundtrack:
- 'Taking Over' by ZET (https://soundcloud.com/nova-co-lr/ch3-taking-over)
- 'Showtime Is Over' by ZET (https://soundcloud.com/nova-co-lr/ch3-showtime-is-over)

Video Editing:
- Video Editing by @Omnirune
